failures.error: The helper expected bootstrap_outer_deadline_seconds in SOURCE_BINDING_R5; the reviewed value is in GENERATED_KERNEL_SEAL_R5.kernel.outer_deadline_seconds.
The helper expected kernel_metadata_sha256 in GENERATED_KERNEL_SEAL_R5; R5 reuses the metadata byte-identically from the reviewed R4 bundle and the seal binds kernel code bytes.
The helper expected R5_BUNDLE_BUILD.manifest_sha256; the producer receipt field is r5_bundle_manifest_sha256.

The helper compared remote dataset_sources ordering to local metadata ordering. All values match as a sorted set; this was order-only. Exact v2 private/READY status, source files, remote code hash and private GPU-only metadata checks had passed before this comparison.

qualification: These are actor-side preflight tooling defects only. They are not cache, profile, model, or quality evidence.
resolution: Per controller instruction, the helper was retired rather than expanded. A compact source-version receipt was made from the already-proven R3 exact Kaggle SDK calls; all provider mutations used separate passing source-version and kernel-push receipts.
scope: A temporary R5-specific provider-preflight helper was attempted, but did not complete its gate and was not used for any provider mutation. The source version and kernel push used the reviewed R3 exact-provider primitives directly.
